record.one_liner: Cloud CRM offering REST APIs and MCP servers for managing leads, contacts, deals, and other sales data via AI agents.
record.auth_notes: Zoho CRM API uses OAuth 2.0 with authorization-code flow; access tokens are short-lived (1 hour) and refresh tokens are long-lived until revoked. Client registration mechanics were not confirmed by a fetched page.
record.access_notes: Zoho CRM's Free edition (self-serve signup, no sales contact) includes API access with a 5000 calls/day limit, per the vendor pricing page.
record.api_breadth_basis: V8 docs list six API categories covering full CRUD on CRM module entities (Leads, Contacts, Deals, etc.), plus Metadata, Composite (batch), Bulk (async), Notification (webhooks), and Query (SELECT-based) APIs.
record.blocker_notes: Free CRM edition provides self-serve API access; official Zoho MCP platform (mcp.zoho.com) also offers free self-serve signup with pre-built CRM MCP servers.

evidence.quote: OAuth 2.0 is an industry-standard protocol specification that enables third-party applications (clients) to gain delegated access to protected resources in Zoho via an API.
CRUD operations on CRM module entities and integrate with any third party application
Zoho users, developers, and partners can log in to access the MCP playground.
